description.eng: Negates the next debuff.
description.zhs: 免疫下一次受到的负面效果。

description.eng: Until next turn, prevents damage.
description.zhs: 持续到下回合开始前，阻挡伤害。

description.eng: Burns are unplayable status cards that damage you.
description.zhs: 灼伤是 不能被打出 的状态牌，并会对你造成伤害。

description.eng: Channeling an Orb puts it into your first empty slot. If you have no empty slots, your first Orb is automatically #yEvoked to make room.
description.zhs: 生成的充能球将出现在你最右侧起的第一个空栏位。当没有空栏位时，你的第一个充能球将自动被 激发 来空出位置。

description.eng: Whenever you draw a card, randomize its cost.
description.zhs: 你每抽到一张牌，就将其耗能随机变化。

description.eng: Curse cards are negative cards that stay in your deck.
description.zhs: 诅咒牌是留在你牌组中的负面牌。

description.eng: Orb: Increases damage every turn. When #yEvoked, deals damage to the enemy with the least HP.
description.zhs: 充能球：每回合增加伤害。 #y激发 时，对生命值最少的敌人造成伤害。

description.eng: Dazed are unplayable status cards.
description.zhs: 晕眩是 不能被打出 的 虚无 状态牌。

description.eng: Dexterity improves Block gained from cards.
description.zhs: 敏捷增加你从牌中获得的格挡值。

description.eng: If this card is in your hand at the end of turn, it is exhausted. Exhausted cards are removed from your deck until the end of combat.
description.zhs: 如果这张牌在回合结束时仍然在你的手中，它将被消耗。被消耗的牌将在战斗结束前被移除出牌组。

description.eng: Consume your rightmost Orb and use its Evoke effect.
description.zhs: 消耗掉你最右侧的充能球，使用其 激发 效果。

description.eng: Removed until end of combat.
description.zhs: 在战斗结束前被移除出牌组。

description.eng: Focus increases the effectiveness of #yChanneled Orbs.
description.zhs: 集中 会加强 充能球 的效果。

description.eng: While Frail, gain #b25% less #yBlock from cards.
description.zhs: 处于脆弱状态时，你从卡牌中获得的 #y格挡 减少 #b25% 。

description.eng: Orb: Gains #yBlock.
description.zhs: 充能球：获得 #y格挡。

description.eng: Start each combat with this card in your hand.
description.zhs: 在每场战斗开始时，这张牌会出现在你的手牌中。

description.eng: Reduce ALL damage taken and HP loss to #b1.
description.zhs: 将受到的所有伤害和生命减少效果降低为 #b1 。

description.eng: Orb: Deals damage to random enemies.
description.zhs: 充能球：对随机敌人造成伤害。

description.eng: This card has yet to be unlocked.
description.zhs: 这张牌还没有被解锁。

description.eng: Lock-On targets receive #b50% more damage from Orbs.
description.zhs: 被跟踪锁定的目标从充能球受到的伤害增加 #b50% 。

description.eng: Opener cards may only be played as the first card each turn.
description.zhs: Opener cards may only be played as the first card each turn.

description.eng: Orb: Gains Energy.
description.zhs: 充能球：获得 能量 。

description.eng: Poisoned creatures lose HP at the start of their turn. Each turn, Poison is reduced by #b1.
description.zhs: 中毒的生物会在他们的回合开始时失去相应的生命。中毒层数每回合下降 #b1 。

description.eng: Retained cards are not discarded at the end of turn.
description.zhs: 保留的牌不会在回合结束时被放入弃牌堆。

description.eng: Shivs are #b0 cost Attack cards which Exhaust.
description.zhs: 小刀是会消耗的 #b0 耗能攻击牌。

description.eng: Status cards are removed at the end of combat.
description.zhs: 状态牌在战斗结束时会被移除。

description.eng: Strength adds additional damage to attacks.
description.zhs: 力量会让攻击获得额外的伤害。

description.eng: Any card with the word "Strike" in its name.
description.zhs: 所有名字中包括“打击”的牌。

description.eng: When receiving #yAttack damage, deals damage back.
description.zhs: 受到 #y攻击 伤害时，对攻击者造成伤害。

description.eng: This card is NOT IMPLEMENTED. Someone should really fix that...
description.zhs: 这张牌还没做完，呃，会出现在这里还真是需要修复一下……

description.eng: Transformed cards become a random card of any rarity.
description.zhs: 被变化的牌会变成随机稀有度的随机牌。

description.eng: This card has yet to be encountered.
description.zhs: 这张牌你还没有遇到过。

description.eng: Unplayable cards cannot be played from your hand.
description.zhs: 不能被打出的牌不能从你的手牌中被打出。

description.eng: Upgrading cards makes them more powerful. Cards can only be upgraded once.
description.zhs: 升级卡牌会让它们变得更加强大。卡牌只能升级一次。

description.eng: Voids are unplayable status cards that consume energy when drawn.
description.zhs: 虚空是 不能被打出 的 虚无 状态牌，在被抽到时会消耗能量。

description.eng: Vulnerable creatures take #b50% more damage from Attacks.
description.zhs: 有易伤效果的生物从攻击中受到的伤害增加 #b50% 。

description.eng: Weakened creatures deal #b25% less damage with Attacks.
description.zhs: 有虚弱效果的生物用攻击造成的伤害减少 #b25% 。

description.eng: Wounds are unplayable status cards.
description.zhs: 伤口是不能被打出的状态牌。

description.eng: In this #yStance, you deal and receive double attack damage.
description.zhs: 在这一 #y姿态 中，你造成和受到双倍攻击伤害。

description.eng: Upon exiting this #yStance, gain [W] [W] .
description.zhs: 离开这一 #y姿态 时，获得 [W] [W] 。

description.eng: You can only have one stance at a time.
description.zhs: 你同一时间只能处于一种姿态。

description.eng: Look at the top X cards of your draw pile. You may discard any of them.
description.zhs: 检视你抽牌堆顶部的X张牌。你可以选择丢弃其中的任意张。

description.eng: Upon entering this stance, gain [W] [W] [W] . Attacks deal triple damage. Exit this #yStance at the start of your next turn.
description.zhs: 进入这一 #y姿态 时，获得 [W] [W] [W] 。你的攻击造成三倍伤害。你在下一回合开始时自动离开这一 #y姿态 。

description.eng: When you obtain #b10 #yMantra, enter #yDivinity.
description.zhs: 当你获得 #b10 层 #y真言 时，进入 #y神格 。

description.eng: Your next Attack deals additional damage.
description.zhs: 你的下一次攻击造成额外伤害。

description.eng: Regen heals HP at the end of your turn. Each turn, Regen is reduced by #b1.
description.zhs: 在你的回合结束时回复相应的生命值。再生每回合减少 #b1 。

description.eng: Gain #yStrength at the end of your turn.
description.zhs: 在你的回合结束时，获得相应点数的 #y力量 。

description.eng: Triggers whenever this card kills a non-minion enemy.
description.zhs: 当用卡牌杀死一名不是“爪牙”的敌人时，触发该效果。
